content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Contract engagement for 1 year; first three months are probation, reviewed by the nodal officer. Extension of the contract is decided by the competent authority on the basis of performance review. Appointment is fully temporary and can be ended on one month's notice; no claim to regular appointment or regularisation. Employment is project-based and temporary in nature. Only the fixed consolidated remuneration is paid; no other benefit or facility; not treated as government servants. No leave other than government holidays when the creche is closed.

content_sections.heading: How Will Madhepura Collectorate Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Merit list based on educational qualification and work experience Interview Final merit list based on educational qualification, work experience and interview Candidates with the prescribed qualification are called for interview according to the merit list. Final merit list is based on educational qualification, work experience and interview. Interview information is sent to the email in the application and posted on the district website (NIC Madhepura). A panel of at least three candidates is prepared, valid for one year and extendable by one more year.

content_sections.text: Get the detailed information and the application format from the district website https://madhepura.nic.in. Fill the application in the prescribed format (Annexure-4) and mention the post applied for. Attach self-attested copies of educational qualification and experience certificates/marksheets and all documents. Send the application with the documents in PDF to [email protected] by 05:00 PM on 05-12-2026. Send a separate application for each post when applying for more than one post. Keep a printout of the filled application with you.
